sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat-Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: CRISPR Therapeutics reports updated data from its in vivo editing programme
feed.summary: The company released updated interim data from an early stage in vivo editing study. Enrolment continues and no dosing changes were announced. Analysts called the readout directionally positive but early.
